choice.basis: The dashboard legend (O2) defines a monotonic color scale where pale yellow corresponds to 'High' prevalence (100) and dark red/maroon corresponds to 'Low' prevalence (0). Comparing the three offered states: New Jersey (NJ) is filled with very pale yellow (O3), Delaware (DE) is filled with a lighter orange/pale yellow (O5), and Pennsylvania (PA) is filled with dark maroon (O4). Since pale yellow represents the highest end of the scale, NJ has the highest prevalence among the options.
choice.option_label: Open New Jersey (NJ) prevalence detail for priority follow-up
